about_the_game:
First released in Xbox One's Indie Creator's Collection in 2016, Psychomachia has undergone an overhaul of improvements and new features for its one decade anniversary debut on Steam.

The battle between the body and the psyche… That is the Psychomachia!

• Explosive local/couch multiplayer fighting game starring characters from the up-and-coming Eternal franchise.

• Fighting fans assemble! Everything you know and love is here, from lightning-fast combos to easy-input supers. Trade blows and unleash your devastating Ultra attack.

• Choose from 15 core fighters, each with his or her own unique fighting style–martial artists, swordmasters, gunners, speedsters, grapplers, hulks–or go with your very own original custom character creation.

• Full Roster Control: In addition to the full character creation mode, each of the 15 core fighters can be customized, even renamed, to make them all your own.

• Let your inner character artist break free with a fully-featured custom character creation mode, boasting a total of 10 male slots and 10 female slots to satisfy the most hardcore character creation aficionados.

• Outfit your team by selecting from a hefty assortment of bodies, faces, hairstyles, clothing, armor, weapons, style-specific items, and more.

• Each character and style earns their own XP, good towards unlocking a host of content to keep the action going strong, including new character-specific pieces for your player portrait.

• Fists aren’t the only things flying here! Enjoy hundreds of hilarious pre-game and post-game quips dished out between the characters and by the in-game commentator.

New features exclusive to the Steam release include:

• Vastly improved gameplay and UI.

• Tactical tile-based turn-based strategy SRPG starring the roster characters.

• Extensive art gallery, including short animations and a 26-page comic book.

• 50 Steam Achievements to take on alone or with a friend.

Suit up and join the fray… of Psychomachia!

100% compatible for play on Steam Deck.

content_descriptors.notes: Female custom character creations can be naked, but the nudity is nongraphic in nature (like a Barbie doll).
